anonymousShopping.title: Anonymous Shopping
anonymousShopping.description: Your identity stays completely private throughout your journey.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Getting started is simple. Create an account, browse anonymously, and shop with complete confidence.

step1.title: Sign Up Anonymously
step1.description: Create your account with just an email or Web3 wallet. No personal information required to start browsing.

step2.title: Browse & Connect
step2.description: Explore verified listings and message sellers through our encrypted chat. Your conversations stay completely private.

step3.title: Secure Payment
step3.description: Complete your purchase with our secure escrow system. Payments are protected until you confirm delivery.

step4.title: Discreet Delivery
step4.description: Receive your items in plain, unmarked packaging. No external labels or branding reveal the contents.
